title: CAN 14 · held-out runs · target, real and twin replays
source: bam_ws reports/media/rack-motor-models-2026-10-23/traj_compare.html (traj_compare payload, built 2026-10-23), matched to /archive/datasets/bam_rig/<day>/<session>/runs/<stem>.npz by data; read 2026-10-26. Real hardware runs; sims are twin replays of their commands.

t.note: Seconds from the run's start (its own t, = the target's start). The payload's display grid: ~93 Hz for the sine and tapes, ~46 Hz for the 36 s staircase (traj_compare decimated it); not resampled here. Metrics in models.json / runs.json come from the full-rate runs, never these rows.

run.note: Short run id; `runs` (top level) maps it to <day>/<session>/runs/<stem> under /archive/datasets/bam_rig. tape A and tape B (rack_2026-10-21/session_03 s01 and s05) play the same medium tape: a real-vs-real repeat.

situation.note: target = the command; real = the rack's encoder; sim_identified (twin identified-d58a5583) and sim_identified_plus (identified+-cf980efe: sticking friction, torque ripple, velocity weakening) = the twins replaying the same command. sim_cad is declared empty upstream: CAN 14's joint is not in the CAD export.

q_deg.note: Joint (board output) angle, rad in the payload, shown in degrees, rounded to 0.001°. The board's zero differs between the 10-21 and 10-23 sessions, so absolute angles are not comparable across days; errors are.

err_mrad.note: q − q_target, signed: the payload's own err_q (stored to 1 µrad), mrad. Null on target rows (no error against itself).

gap_mrad.note: q_sim − q_real at the same t, signed, mrad: the twin's miss. Null for target and real rows.
